answer: Every honest piece carries a mark, and every mark traces back to a name in the book. Carter wagon tally with carters attestation is the book that ties mark to maker: eight-year tally, 3,000 loads carried, horse accounts, annual review. Sell an unmarked piece under a forged walnut and the sale is undone, the seller refunds the buyer twice the price and the kernel is paid to the guild chest, while the gale is kept in the register and shown at the yearly visitation.
